capabilities: Render blockie identicons inline next to matched addresses
Keep the original address text readable and copyable
Toggle display in Live Preview and Reading mode
Configure icon size and icon side
extras: README notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; docs are provided in English and Japanese, and beta installs are supported via the BRAT plugin.
problem: Raw 0x-style wallet addresses in notes are hard to tell apart at a glance because Obsidian shows them as plain text.

relations.evidence: The blockie algorithm is included locally so the plugin does not depend on the archived ethereum/blockies package at runtime.

summary: Renders deterministic blockie identicons inline next to Ethereum wallet addresses in Live Preview and Reading mode.
